title: Questions 147-148 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
NOTICE

We have received a number of complaints from tenants of this apartment building about the shared bicycle racks in the ground-floor storage room. It has come to our attention that the wheel channels are not always being cleared of mud and gravel after the racks are used. This has caused the locking arms to jam, which creates a risk of damage to bicycles. It has also made them release without warning, letting frames fall against one another.

Please remember to brush all debris from the channel after every use. If you come across a rack that is not working properly, do not try to repair it yourself; instead, report it to the building superintendent.

Thank you for helping us keep this space safe for everyone.
